actual_scope: Exact #7621 word (our courier + helper re-stop on SYLforge's #7620 stationary primal/dual composition): 14 instances of SYLforge's loan + stationary-snapshot device (#7616/#7620), all side A. In each, register r drops an interior stop X and a partner p gains the chart A before X; the work r would have done at X rides a loan through a carrier register that passes A, X, B, and p picks up r's X-writes directly or from a stationary owned snapshot (INIT, one write, one read, dirty CLEAR, no MOVE), with a signed role swap between r and p and a settle at B. 13 new stationary owned lifetimes, one per snapshot (instance 348@399 needs none). Rows, end charts, owned data (47 owned MOVEs, peak 50, 68 labels, 1,018 old owned observations) and all 167 old CLEAR contents are #7621's; 24 new strictly nested chart pairs, 14 leave. Packaged with the engine that produced it (engine/): rerunning engine/run_on.py on #7621's word reproduces this word. Conditional on exactly #7620's premises (its five inherited assumptions, its fixed 17*68 bank allocation) with its CLEAR reading now covering 180 CLEARs (74 + 106 stationary), not 167.
scope_change_reason: Applies SYLforge's loan + stationary-snapshot device (#7616, #7620) to #7621's word by an exact builder that finds the instances (census), solves the template coefficients exactly, and accepts a hit only after exact replay, owned-observation equality and a kappa gain; the builder is published with the word so others can run the passes themselves.
bottleneck_link: Reduces the complete signed paid invoice by {1:+17, 2:+221, 3:-476, 4:+221, 5:+17} over the 17 native calls (paid positions unchanged at 110145, rank-weighted S 1424 unchanged) without changing the productive profile.
stop_rule: One literal word with exact arbitrary-input row equality, legality, identical old CLEAR content, certificates for the new CLEARs, all affected-pair column tests (964 pairs), complete invoice, a certified crossing, and an engine rerun that reproduces the word.
